# Email Reciever

> A Chinese reading site that collects developer newsletters, RSS feeds and
> archive pages, translates them into Simplified Chinese, and archives them as
> plain Markdown on GitHub. 2,500+ posts from 27 sources.

## Site

- [Home / archive](https://email-reciever-website.jiangjiangjiangxi.workers.dev/): filterable list of every post (source, search, pagination in the URL).
- [Subscribe](https://email-reciever-website.jiangjiangjiangxi.workers.dev/subscribe): feed URL and subscription instructions.
- [RSS feed](https://email-reciever-website.jiangjiangjiangxi.workers.dev/rss.xml): RSS 2.0, latest 50 posts.
- [Sitemap](https://email-reciever-website.jiangjiangjiangxi.workers.dev/sitemap.xml): every post URL with lastmod dates.

## How the site works

- Content lives at `content/{author}/{YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss_SSS}.md` in the
  GitHub repository `email-reciever/website`, branch `main`.
- `manifest.json` at the repository root is the index. Each entry has
  `author`, `slug`, `title`, `description`, `date`, `origin_url`, `translated`.
- Detail page URLs are `/post/{author}/{slug}` — the same slugs as the files.
- The site fetches raw Markdown at request time from
  `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/content/{author}/{slug}.md`
  and renders it with @tanstack/markdown + sanitize-html.

## Direct raw URLs for LLMs

- Index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/manifest.json
- A post: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/content/{author}/{slug}.md
- Architecture: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/docs/architecture.md
- Visual system: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/email-reciever/website/main/docs/design-system.md

## Source whitelist (author keys)

ajiang, alexkondov, arcupdate, astro, cloudflareblog, csstricks, frontendfocus,
garymarcus, importai, insidergithub, javascriptweekly, mediumcom, mittechai,
modular, awsml, nodeweekly, others, producthunt, reactdigest, reactstatus, rnn,
smashingmag, syntaxfm, svelte, tyler, typescript, zhihu

## Notes

- `translated: true` means the body is a Chinese translation; `false` means
  translation was unavailable and the body is the original English text.
- Frontmatter is real YAML. Code blocks are protected during translation with
  positional placeholders and restored afterwards.
- The site is SSR on Cloudflare Workers; there is no API key or login required
  to read any content.
